# The inflate corpus: DEFLATE and zlib streams produced by compcol.
#
# Generated out of tree by a program that calls compcol's public API and
# nothing else; compcol is not a dependency of this repository and what is
# committed here is what it produced. `docs/ip-library.md` and
# `ip/compress/inflate/README.md` §3 say how, and how the cases were
# chosen.
#
# One record per stream:
#   case  <name> <tier> <wrapper>
#   gen   <rule> <length> <adler32 of the plaintext, hex>
#   first <bfinal> <btype>     -- of the first block, RFC 1951 §3.2.3
#   note  <why this case is here>
#   hex   <the stream, 64 bytes a line>
#
# The plaintext is not stored: it is `plaintext(rule, length)` in
# tests/ip_library.rs, which is the same rule the generator used. The
# adler32 is there so that a rule that stops matching is reported as a
# rule mismatch rather than as a decompressor fault.
#
# `tier` is `fast` for the cases the gate runs and `bulk` for the ones an
# #[ignore]d test runs, which are the ones measured in hundreds of
# thousands of simulated cycles.

case pattern_0_l6_zlib fast zlib
gen pattern 0 00000001
first 1 1
note a short plaintext, one of each length
hex 789c030000000001

first 1 1
note a short plaintext, one of each length
hex 0300
